item.title: Leading with Love During the Holidays
item.description: In this episode of Warriors of Grace, Dave Jenkins calls Christian men to lead with Christlike love during the holidays, drawing from Colossians 3:12–14 and John 13:34–35. The episode addresses holiday stress, family tensions, and practical ways men can reflect the love of Christ at home and in the church.

item.title: Truth Isn’t a Feeling: Standing Firm in a Relativistic Age
item.description: In this Contending for the Word episode, Dave Jenkins explains why truth is not a feeling, how relativism reshapes faith, and how Christians stand firm in God’s revealed truth.

item.title: Jesus Is Our Good Shepherd
item.description: Join Doreen Virtue on New Age to Christ as she explores Jesus as our Good Shepherd through Psalm 23 and John 10. Reflect, trust, and grow in Christ.

item.title: Esther 3, The Plot Against God’s People
item.description: Esther 3 reveals a deadly plot against God’s people and highlights the sovereign providence of God even in the darkest moments. In this episode of Reading the Bible Daily with Dave, Dave Jenkins walks through Esther 3, showing how God’s redemptive plan stands firm against evil and points us to Christ.
